title: Applications of Solvents in Nanopharmaceuticals
content: The main objective of the present study was to investigate the application of solvents and nanoparticles as pharmaceutical nanocarriers in the pharmaceutical industry. This descriptive study was conducted in June 2021 based on relevant sources and scientific articles. The study focused on the applications of solvents in nanopharmaceuticals and aimed to elucidate their role and relevance in this field. Based on the findings of the reviewed literature, the use of nanocarriers can enhance drug efficacy and improve the uniformity of nanoparticles in terms of size and structural characteristics. Nanotechnology enables targeted drug delivery and allows control over the timing, location, and rate of drug release. The functionalization or conjugation of nanopolymers may reduce drug toxicity, while hydrolysis-based mechanisms can contribute to drug release. Nanopharmaceutical systems involving biomolecules such as lysozyme may exhibit dipolar characteristics and liquid-crystalline behavior, resulting in properties associated with both liquid and solid states. Overall, the application of nanopharmaceutical technologies can improve the quality of pharmaceutical products and enhance the efficiency of drug production. Further research is recommended to investigate the potential applications of nanopharmaceuticals in the prevention and treatment of COVID-19.
